title: How I Helped the Gravel National Champ Make a Surprising Bike Choice
content:
Cobe Freeburn’s winning setup for the US Gravel National Championship wasn't a top-down corporate directive. It all started months earlier with two guys messing around with an unreleased bike in a parking lot.

Read the full article at How I Helped the Gravel National Champ Make a Surprising Bike Choice on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
